I therefore retain positive momentum but partially normalize the May one-off rather than extrapolating the full $164.8 billion change."},{"kind":"text","text":"Prior/update/interval: the persistence prior starts from the latest official DSPI level of 23651.7; the historical sample is the 12 successive changes from June 2025 through May 2026: 41.5, 139.0, 105.9, 82.6, -28.8, 48.0, 55.1, 230.0, -13.5, 128.0, -23.5, and 164.8. Their sample standard deviation is sigma = 80.0, so the 80% half-width is roughly 1.28*sigma = 102.4. Combining persistence, wage momentum, and partial farm-payment normalization gives a point of 23730; the interval is 23730 +/- 100, or 23630 to 23830. No extra widening is applied because the interval already reflects the high-dispersion monthly-change regime."},{"kind":"math","text":"Point calculation: 23651.7 latest level plus an approximately 78.3 billion normalized June increase equals 23730 after rounding.
